proof_body:
by
  intro V _ G hV
  classical
  obtain ⟨v⟩ : Nonempty V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  have hcount : ((Finset.univ.erase v).filter (fun x => G.Adj v x)).card + ((Finset.univ.erase v).filter (fun x => ¬ G.Adj v x)).card = (Finset.univ.erase v).card := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
  have herase : (Finset.univ.erase v).card = Fintype.card V - 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ v), Finset.card_univ]
  rcases (by omega : 2 < ((Finset.univ.erase v).filter (fun x => G.Adj v x)).card ∨ 2 < ((Finset.univ.erase v).filter (fun x => ¬ G.Adj v x)).card) with hN | hM
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, c, hc, hab, hac, hbc⟩ := Finset.two_lt_card.mp hN
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true] at ha hb hc
    by_cases h1 : G.Adj a b
    · exact ⟨v, a, b, ha.1.symm, hb.1.symm, hab, Or.inl ⟨ha.2, hb.2, h1⟩⟩
    by_cases h2 : G.Adj a c
    · exact ⟨v, a, c, ha.1.symm, hc.1.symm, hac, Or.inl ⟨ha.2, hc.2, h2⟩⟩
    by_cases h3 : G.Adj b c
    · exact ⟨v, b, c, hb.1.symm, hc.1.symm, hbc, Or.inl ⟨hb.2, hc.2, h3⟩⟩
    exact ⟨a, b, c, hab, hac, hbc, Or.inr ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, c, hc, hab, hac, hbc⟩ := Finset.two_lt_card.mp hM
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true] at ha hb hc
    by_cases h1 : G.Adj a b
    · by_cases h2 : G.Adj a c
      · by_cases h3 : G.Adj b c
        · exact ⟨a, b, c, hab, hac, hbc, Or.inl ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩⟩
        · exact ⟨v, b, c, hb.1.symm, hc.1.symm, hbc, Or.inr ⟨hb.2, hc.2, h3⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨v, a, c, ha.1.symm, hc.1.symm, hac, Or.inr ⟨ha.2, hc.2, h2⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨v, a, b, ha.1.symm, hb.1.symm, hab, Or.inr ⟨ha.2, hb.2, h1⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), 6 ≤ Fintype.card V → ∃ a b c : V, a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c ∧ ((G.Adj a b ∧ G.Adj a c ∧ G.Adj b c) ∨ (¬ G.Adj a b ∧ ¬ G.Adj a c ∧ ¬ G.Adj b c))
